_comments.app.name: Human-readable name — shown by /api/health and in the UI.
_comments.app.slug: Short machine id (lowercase, dashes). Used for things that must be unique per app on one host, e.g. the session cookie name.
_comments.app.host: 127.0.0.1 = this machine only (safe default). 0.0.0.0 = every network interface (LAN, VPN) — set it on purpose.
_comments.app.port: 8080 is Ote's reserved template default (rule XX YY Z, zone 08 id 08). Give a real project its own port; the test instance uses port + 1.
_comments.app.public_origins: Extra sites allowed to call this API from a browser, e.g. ["https://app.example.com"]. Same-origin needs nothing. Never "*".
_comments.app.trust_proxy: false, or the reverse proxy's address / hop count (e.g. "127.0.0.1" or 1) so request.ip is the real visitor. Never true.
_comments.app.body_limit_mb: Largest accepted request body in megabytes (Fastify default is 1).
_comments.logging.request: log_headers / log_query / log_body add request content to the request log — off by default; secrets are redacted even when on.
_comments.logging.retention_days: Delete log files and log_* rows older than this many days (daily at 03:15 and at startup). 0 = keep forever.
_comments.database.enabled: false = no database: the app still runs; DB-backed routes answer 503 db_disabled.
_comments.database.schema_mode: migrate (default, Postgres) = the SQL files in database/migrations/ own the schema; run `npm run db:migrate` before starting — the server refuses to start with pending migrations. sync = models create missing tables (prototypes, SQLite, other dialects); never alters.
_comments.database.connection.dialect: postgres (first-class) · mysql · mariadb · mssql · sqlite. Each needs its driver installed in Backend: pg (included) · mysql2 · mariadb · tedious · sqlite3 (native module: a SQLite project can't become a portable EXE).
_comments.database.connection.schemas.project: Postgres: this app's own schema (one database, one schema per app). Tests use <project>_test. Ignored by other dialects.
_comments.database.connection.storage: SQLite only: the database file, relative to Backend/.
_comments.auth: OPTIONAL sign-in module (app/modules/auth). enabled:false = no sign-in anywhere. The wizard fills the secret and the root password hash.
_comments.auth.session: secret: 32+ random chars (wizard generates). cookie_name: empty = <app.slug>_session (unique per app — apps on one host must not share it). secure: auto = only over https.
_comments.auth.root: The config account: works with no database and with Oteracount down. password_hash is bcrypt — make one with `npm run auth:hash-password`.
_comments.auth.local_users: Accounts in the mst_users table (needs the database + migration 003). Manage with `npm run auth:user`.
_comments.auth.oteracount: Login with Oteracount (Ote's OIDC provider). Register the client first — see C:\data\Otenization\Reference\docs\GUIDE_OOAuth_for_apps.md. Keys keep the guide's names. redirectUri = <public origin>/api/auth/oteracount/callback, exactly as registered.
_comments.auth.roles: role -> permissions. '*' = everything. Use with fastify.requirePermission('x') on routes.
_comments.realtime: OPTIONAL push to browsers: sse -> GET /api/events, websocket -> GET /api/ws. Both fed by fastify.realtime.publish(channel, type, data). Push only — actions go through the API.
_comments.files: OPTIONAL uploads (app/modules/files). One API, two drivers: local = a folder + signed links (no other service); bloteb = Ote's file service. Store only the file id in your rows.
_comments.files.types: Allowed types, checked against the REAL type detected from the bytes (image/* allowed as a family). Empty = any. Unknown bytes are application/octet-stream and always download.
_comments.files.local: directory relative to Backend/. Needs security.secret_box_key (signs the read links). Unclaimed uploads are purged after 24 h.
_comments.files.bloteb: Register the app in Bloteb first (GUIDE_Bloteb_for_apps.md §4): app = its slug, key = the bk1.… private key (config.json only, never git). baseUrl = what browsers use; internalBaseUrl = optional, when this backend runs on Bloteb's box.
_comments.security.secret_box_key: Key for lib/crypto-box.js makeBox() — seal recoverable secrets (API keys, SMTP passwords) before storing them. 32+ random chars (wizard generates).
